map.design_purpose: Bounded sandpit dimensions and terrain character (D-003). height_scale sets how tall hills get in blocks; frequencies set how quickly terrain and biomes change while walking - lower is broader features.

biomes.design_purpose: High ground owns stone and iron; Stone Husks make taking them feel like a claim, and the climb telegraphs risk
The dangerous quarter that holds the trial gate: fire creatures preview the Tyrant's element and the ground itself looks burnt
Wood country: dense trees with hound packs prowling, so bulk timber runs stay tense
The gentle fallback biome and starting country: sparse resources, near-empty of threats, readable in every direction

nodes.design_purpose: What each scattered node yields per E-press and how much it holds before depleting; visual keys pick the greybox mesh/texture

guarantees.design_purpose: D-003 authored-content rules: every valid seed starts in a safe flat meadow clearing, has enough wood/stone/iron within a short walk to reach the forge, keeps mob packs off the doorstep, and places the trial gate far away in the wastes so it is an ambition before it is a destination
